{{italic title|List of outfits in ''Super Mario Odyssey''}} ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]'' features several '''outfits''', composed of a hat that is transformed into by [[Cappy]], clothing worn by [[Mario]], or both a hat and clothing. Most hats and clothing can be purchased from [[Crazy Cap]]; others can be obtained by scanning [[amiibo]] figures, and some are obtained by progressing the game's story. A total of 58 outfits are present in the game; 14 of these are considered "special" outfits, which were added in [[Super Mario Odyssey#Ver. 1.2.0|version 1.2.0]] and are not counted towards the game's [[completion]]. 55 hats and 55 clothing pieces are available. Outfits can be chosen using a [[closet]], and hats and clothing from different outfits can be freely combined. Wearing a complete outfit is needed to access certain areas and obtain [[Power Moon]]s. Many outfits are based on those worn by Mario in previous games and artwork. ''Super Mario Odyssey'' represents the first game to include this type of outfit system, and similar systems with returning outfits would appear in ''[[Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit]]'', ''[[Mario Kart Tour]]'', and ''[[Mario Kart World]]''. ==Outfits== Outfit names are provided by ''[[The Art of Super Mario Odyssey]]'' where available. {|class="wikitable sortable col1center col2center mario sm center" width="100%" !Outfit !Hat/Clothing !class="unsortable"|Description !class="unsortable"|Unlock method !class="unsortable"|Notes |-id="1.1" |rowspan=2|Mario Cap and Suit |data-sort-value="Mario Cap"|[[File:SMO Mario Cap.png|100px]]

''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]'' features several '''outfits''', composed of a hat that is transformed into by [[Cappy]], clothing worn by [[Mario]], or both a hat and clothing. Most hats and clothing can be purchased from [[Crazy Cap]]; others can be obtained by scanning [[amiibo]] figures, and some are obtained by progressing the game's story. A total of 58 outfits are present in the game; 14 of these are considered "special" outfits, which were added in [[Super Mario Odyssey#Ver. 1.2.0|version 1.2.0]] and are not counted towards the game's [[completion]]. 55 hats and 55 clothing pieces are available. Outfits can be chosen using a [[closet]], and hats and clothing from different outfits can be freely combined. Wearing a complete outfit is needed to access certain areas and obtain [[Power Moon]]s. Many outfits are based on those worn by Mario in previous games and artwork.
